svg.aria-label: MiNet PMS — point of sale / receipt
svg.text: MINET PMS — POINT OF SALE / RECEIPT
The till — one screen, from scan to change
Search drug by name or scan barcode…
Focused on load, so a barcode gun and a keyboard are
the same input. Enter on a single match adds it.
The shelf’s truth, in the list
48 in stock, 3 left, Out of stock — colour-coded, and
unselectable at zero. Expired stock never appears.
Quantity is a stepper, not a field
Corrections at a counter are one more or one fewer,
and a stepper cannot produce a typo.
Change Due is computed and the tender chips match
how notes arrive. No mental subtraction under a queue.
Disabled while the cart is empty, or while cash
tendered is under the total and change would go short.
The printed slip and the SMS copy render from the
same thing, so the two copies cannot disagree.
